# Growvidence

> Don't just learn. Prove your progress.

Growvidence is an evidence-first learning tracker for IT beginners, students and self-taught learners. Tracks, tasks and the learning journal are available in the browser-local workspace. Competency tracking and evidence review are planned.

## Product principles

- Task completion is activity, not proof of competency.
- Evidence connects practice, artifacts, independent demonstration and feedback.
- AI assistance should be disclosed clearly.
- The app stores learner records locally in this browser's IndexedDB.

## Privacy and product status

- No accounts, analytics, app-set cookies or learner-record uploads.
- Backup/export and import are planned, not implemented.
- Read the public [Privacy Policy](https://manayab.github.io/Growvidence/privacy/).
